about: Ground truth for the Clean Reader benchmark (SRS PM-CR-SRS-001 section 9). Each label is a short piece of text copied from the PDF's own text layer, with the type a person gives it after looking at the page. Labels were drafted by Claude from the raw PyMuPDF text and page coordinates (not from the extractor's output) on 2026-11-16 and still need a human check. The PDFs themselves are not in git: put them in evals/clean_reader/pdfs/ under the file name given here.

fields.type: one of the types in run_clean_reader.GROUPS
fields.text: matched after normalisation (NFKC, lower case, spaces collapsed, Markdown marks and soft hyphens removed, curly quotes straightened)
fields.whole: true: must be a whole block of the reading flow, not part of one (page numbers, short headings)
fields.max_in_flow: how many times the text may appear in the reading flow; 0 unless given (a running header that repeats the title may appear once, as the title)
fields.order: pairs [a, b]: in the reading flow a comes before b; [a, b, "next"]: b follows a with nothing else in between (same block or the next one)
fields.sha256_prefix: first 10 hex digits of the file's SHA-256, checked before a run
fields.expect: outcomes checked besides the labels: ocr_pages ('all' or a list of page numbers)
